description: Generate one call, or an atomic batch of decodable VeToken steps, claiming voter fees from one or more ve-tokens. Fees only: votes, stake amounts, lock ends, and NFT ownership are all unchanged, so this is always safe to run before any other ve(3,3) action.

chain_id.description: With ve_token, from get_ve33_allocations (STONX: 4663), not the wallet's chain

pool_key.description: PoolKey {token0, token1, config} or {token0, token1, fee, tick_spacing, extension, stableswap_params?}, as read from the pool or vote

name: prepare_ve33_claim_fees
title: Prepare ve-token fee claims
